---
title: "Behind the Scenes"
---

The music map uses the sentence each person wrote about how their song makes them feel. The AI word cloud uses the one-sentence definition of artificial intelligence from the survey.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
src=Path("docs_data/responses_anon.csv")
if src.exists():
    df=pd.read_csv(src)
    if "ai_definition" in df:
        display(df["ai_definition"].dropna().head(3).tolist())
```
